snippet.title: Fire Up Together   Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🔥 **Fire Up Together is coming to Steam!**

Grab your hose, team up with your friends, and climb as high as you can! 🚒💦

Use pressurized water to launch yourself through the air, extinguish fires, overcome physics-based obstacles, and work together in this chaotic co-op adventure.

👨‍🚒 Play solo or with up to 4 players
💦 Physics-based hose mechanics
🚀 Launch yourself with water pressure
🔥 Extinguish fires and overcome obstacles
🏆 Climb higher together!

❤️ **Wishlist Fire Up Together on Steam:**
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5133510/Fire_Up_Together/

Every wishlist helps us a lot and supports the development of the game. Thank you! ❤️
